# CodeDiffChangeLine

One line of a changed section.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `type` | [`CodeDiffChangeLineType`](code-diff-change-line-type.md) | Whether the line was added, removed or left unchanged. |
| `text` | `string` | The line's text, without the leading `+` or `-`. |

## Example

```json
{
  "type": "Added",
  "text": "..."
}
```

## Where it's used

- Inside [`CodeDiffChange`](code-diff-change.md)
